9: /-- Equality on the circle is exactly equality modulo P*Z. This is the
10: descent-and-injectivity criterion for the angular quotient, not a definition
11: of the value of the period. -/
12: def AngularQuotientFaithful (kappa period : ℝ) : Prop :=
13:   ∀ t u : ℝ, Circle.exp (kappa*t) = Circle.exp (kappa*u) ↔
14:     ∃ n : ℤ, t = u + (n : ℝ)*period
15: 
16: theorem faithful_period_forces_one_turn {kappa period : ℝ} (hk : kappa ≠ 0)
17:     (h : AngularQuotientFaithful kappa period) :
18:     kappa*period = 2*Real.pi ∨ kappa*period = -(2*Real.pi) := by
19:   have hp : Circle.exp (kappa*period) = 1 := by
20:     have hh := (h period 0).mpr ⟨1, by simp⟩
21:     simpa using hh
22:   obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Circle.exp_eq_one.mp hp
23:   have hr : Circle.exp (kappa*(2*Real.pi/kappa)) = Circle.exp (kappa*0) := by
24:     rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hk]
25:     simp
26:   obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (h (2*Real.pi/kappa) 0).mp hr
27:   have hm' : 2*Real.pi = (m : ℝ)*(kappa*period) := by
28:     have hh := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => kappa*x) hm
29:     rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hk] at hh
30:     calc
31:       2*Real.pi = kappa*(0+(m : ℝ)*period) := hh
32:       _ = (m : ℝ)*(kappa*period) := by ring
33:   have hmnR : (m : ℝ)*(n : ℝ) = 1 := by
34:     apply mul_right_cancel₀ (show (2*Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 by positivity)
35:     calc
36:       (m : ℝ)*(n : ℝ)*(2*Real.pi) = (m : ℝ)*(kappa*period) := by rw [hn]; ring
37:       _ = 1*(2*Real.pi) := by simpa using hm'.symm
38:   have hmn : m*n = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hmnR
39:   have hnunit : IsUnit n := ⟨⟨n,m,by simpa [mul_comm] using hmn,hmn⟩,rfl⟩
40:   have hnabs : |n| = 1 := Int.isUnit_iff_abs_eq.mp hnunit
41:   have hnchoice : n = 1 ∨ n = -1 := by
42:     rcases le_total 0 n with hpos | hneg
43:     · left; simpa [abs_of_nonneg hpos] using hnabs
44:     · right
45:       have hh : -n = 1 := by simpa [abs_of_nonpos hneg] using hnabs
46:       omega
47:   rcases hnchoice with hn1 | hnm1
48:   · left; simpa [hn1] using hn
49:   · right; simpa [hnm1] using hn
50: 
51: theorem one_turn_gives_faithful_period {kappa period : ℝ} (hk : kappa ≠ 0)
52:     (hp : kappa*period = 2*Real.pi ∨ kappa*period = -(2*Real.pi)) :
53:     AngularQuotientFaithful kappa period := by
54:   intro t u
55:   rcases hp with hp | hp
56:   · constructor
57:     · intro hh
58:       obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Circle.exp_eq_exp.mp hh
59:       refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
60:       apply mul_left_cancel₀ hk
61:       calc
62:         kappa*t = kappa*u + (n : ℝ)*(2*Real.pi) := hn
63:         _ = kappa*(u+(n : ℝ)*period) := by rw [← hp]; ring
64:     · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
65:       apply Circle.exp_eq_exp.mpr
66:       refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
67:       rw [hn, ← hp]
68:       ring
69:   · constructor
70:     · intro hh
71:       obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Circle.exp_eq_exp.mp hh
72:       refine ⟨-n, ?_⟩
73:       apply mul_left_cancel₀ hk
74:       calc
75:         kappa*t = kappa*u + (n : ℝ)*(2*Real.pi) := hn
76:         _ = kappa*(u+((-n : ℤ) : ℝ)*period) := by
77:           push_cast
78:           have hh := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (n : ℝ)*x) hp
79:           nlinarith
80:     · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
81:       apply Circle.exp_eq_exp.mpr
82:       refine ⟨-n, ?_⟩
83:       rw [hn]
84:       push_cast
85:       have hh := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (n : ℝ)*x) hp
86:       nlinarith
87: 
88: theorem faithful_period_iff {kappa period : ℝ} (hk : kappa ≠ 0) :
89:     AngularQuotientFaithful kappa period ↔
90:       kappa*period = 2*Real.pi ∨ kappa*period = -(2*Real.pi) :=
91:   ⟨faithful_period_forces_one_turn hk, one_turn_gives_faithful_period hk⟩
92: 
93: theorem positive_faithful_period {kappa period : ℝ} (hk : 0 < kappa)
94:     (hp : 0 < period) (h : AngularQuotientFaithful kappa period) :
95:     period = 2*Real.pi/kappa := by
96:   rcases faithful_period_forces_one_turn (ne_of_gt hk) h with hh | hh
97:   · apply (eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hk)).mpr
98:     simpa [mul_comm] using hh
99:   · have := mul_pos hk hp
100:     have := Real.pi_pos
101:     linarith
102: 
103: theorem reciprocal_temperature {kappa period : ℝ} (hk : 0 < kappa)
104:     (hp : 0 < period) (h : AngularQuotientFaithful kappa period) :
105:     1/period = kappa/(2*Real.pi) := by
106:   rw [positive_faithful_period hk hp h]
107:   field_simp
108:

7: def periodSetoid (period : ℝ) : Setoid ℝ where
8:   r t u := ∃ n : ℤ, t = u + (n : ℝ)*period
9:   iseqv := {
10:     refl := fun t => ⟨0, by simp⟩
11:     symm := by
12:       intro t u h
13:       obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
14:       refine ⟨-n, ?_⟩
15:       push_cast
16:       linarith
17:     trans := by
18:       intro t u v htu huv
19:       obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := htu
20:       obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := huv
21:       refine ⟨m+n, ?_⟩
22:       push_cast
23:       nlinarith }
24: 
25: /-- General descent criterion, with an actual quotient map and injectivity. -/
26: theorem injective_quotient_factor_iff {A B : Type*} (s : Setoid A) (f : A → B) :
27:     (∃ F : Quotient s → B,
28:       (∀ t, F (Quotient.mk s t) = f t) ∧ Function.Injective F) ↔
29:       ∀ t u, f t = f u ↔ s.r t u := by
30:   constructor
31:   · rintro ⟨F, hF, hi⟩ t u
32:     constructor
33:     · intro hh
34:       apply Quotient.exact
35:       apply hi
36:       simpa only [hF] using hh
37:     · intro hh
38:       have he := congrArg F (Quotient.sound hh)
39:       simpa only [hF] using he
40:   · intro h
41:     let F : Quotient s → B := Quotient.lift f (fun t u hh => (h t u).mpr hh)
42:     refine ⟨F, fun t => rfl, ?_⟩
43:     intro x y
44:     refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y ?_
45:     intro t u hh
46:     exact Quotient.sound ((h t u).mp hh)
47: 
48: /-- Complex coordinates identify the ordinary Euclidean plane R^2. -/
49: def polarPoint (radius kappa t : ℝ) : ℂ :=
50:   (radius : ℂ) * (Circle.exp (kappa*t) : ℂ)
51: 
52: theorem polarPoint_eq_iff {radius kappa t u : ℝ} (hr : radius ≠ 0) :
53:     polarPoint radius kappa t = polarPoint radius kappa u ↔
54:       Circle.exp (kappa*t) = Circle.exp (kappa*u) := by
55:   unfold polarPoint
56:   constructor
57:   · intro hh
58:     apply Subtype.ext
59:     exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hr) hh
60:   · intro hh
61:     rw [hh]
62: 
63: theorem polar_descends_injectively_iff {radius kappa period : ℝ}
64:     (hr : 0 < radius) (hk : kappa ≠ 0) :
65:     (∃ F : Quotient (periodSetoid period) → ℂ,
66:       (∀ t, F (Quotient.mk (periodSetoid period) t) = polarPoint radius kappa t) ∧
67:       Function.Injective F) ↔
68:       kappa*period = 2*Real.pi ∨ kappa*period = -(2*Real.pi) := by
69:   rw [injective_quotient_factor_iff]
70:   have he : (∀ t u, polarPoint radius kappa t = polarPoint radius kappa u ↔
71:       (periodSetoid period).r t u) ↔ AngularQuotientFaithful kappa period := by
72:     simp only [polarPoint_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hr), AngularQuotientFaithful]
73:     rfl
74:   rw [he, faithful_period_iff hk]
75: 
76: /-- The positive-temperature reading follows from an injective polar quotient.
77: It is not, by itself, a KMS theorem for a Lorentzian quantum state. -/
78: theorem polar_quotient_reciprocal_temperature {radius kappa period : ℝ}
79:     (hr : 0 < radius) (hk : 0 < kappa) (hp : 0 < period)
80:     (h : ∃ F : Quotient (periodSetoid period) → ℂ,
81:       (∀ t, F (Quotient.mk (periodSetoid period) t) = polarPoint radius kappa t) ∧
82:       Function.Injective F) : 1/period = kappa/(2*Real.pi) := by
83:   apply reciprocal_temperature hk hp
84:   exact (faithful_period_iff (ne_of_gt hk)).mpr
85:     ((polar_descends_injectively_iff hr (ne_of_gt hk)).mp h)
86:

89: #print axioms polarPoint_eq_iff
90: #print axioms polar_descends_injectively_iff
91: #print axioms polar_quotient_reciprocal_temperature
92: end ChatgptAudit.PolarPeriod016
